cards.title: Farm Site Builds
cards.desc: Whole facilities from first drawing to final bolt — bins, towers, and everything between, designed on a screen and built out of steel.
cards.cta: Watch the build shorts on YouTube →

cards.title: Weld It, Fix It
cards.desc: If it's metal, it's fixable. Welding and fabrication saves — cracked, bent, broken, or built wrong the first time.
cards.cta: Watch the fix shorts on TikTok →

cards.title: The Fix-It List
cards.desc: Cars, equipment, stuff around the house — if it can be fixed, it's getting fixed. Real-life Minecraft, one repair at a time.

cards.title: Project Shorts
cards.desc: The builds in 60 seconds or less. There's a whole backlog still to show — the shorts are where it lands first.

cards.title: New drive at the bin
cards.desc: A fresh auger drive and motor bolted up at the bin base — belt on, ready to move grain.

cards.title: Inside the bin
cards.desc: The view nobody posts: block drying channels, leftover grain, and the center auger line.

cards.title: New auger, staged and ready
cards.desc: A fresh unload auger laid out on an empty bin floor, ready to bolt in.

cards.title: Sweep earning its keep
cards.desc: The bin sweep working through the last of the grain, pulling it to the center.

cards.title: Fab work in the yard 🎬
cards.desc: Fitting plate on a fan housing — clamps, a hammer, and patience. Frame from a shop clip; the full video lives on the channel.

cards.title: The view from up top 🎬
cards.desc: Shot from the top of the build — bin tops, the tower, and the whole town below. Frame from a short; watch the clips on the channel.

cards.title: Grain cleaning system build
cards.desc: A whole grain cleaning system going up inside the building — steel, augers, and a deadline named harvest.

cards.title: 130′ grain pump — tandem pick
cards.desc: Setting a 130-foot grain pump along the top of four grain bins. Two cranes, one pick — not for the weak.

cards.title: The first whoop — still flying
cards.desc: The first whoop I ever built — tiny, hand-built, and still flying. Freestyle flips, powerloops, and the odd powerline. The flights go out live on Kick, straight from the goggles; streams are on a break right now, back soon.
